notes.title: Drift Scoring System (DSS)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Driftheads![/h1]

[b]For Today.[/b] Work is in progress, game is testing and improving.

[b]About Interesting.[/b] We are making a game with championships with new score systems.

[b]In the end of 2015,[/b] game was based on browser platform, there was an idea to make Global drift championship. In 2016 we start to test new score system, we called it Drift Scoring System (DSS).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/5a947cb64c0e4ee81a325397c8f845683ce308c4.png[/img]
All worked fine, but were faced the problems:
[list]
[*]Bad game physics
[*]Not enough drift tracks
[*]etc.
[/list]

[b]Game Physics.[/b]
We went to the core and rebuilt it. We made physics more dynamic with more deeper interactions, more reliable and more realistic. "Fun to play, hard to master". We will hope that you will like it! It will be fun, but difficult enough.

[b]Not enough tracks.[/b]
Our current tracks completely didn’t fit the new standards of the game (physics and championships).
We decided to look at Formula Drift. Dynamic track configurations, complex terrain, bankings, concrete blocks. It looks very cool, and I hope it will also look cool in the game, because now these tracks are in game.


[b]It was a short prehistory. [/b] Now about [i]DSS[/i].

Glossary of terms:
[list]
[*][b]DSS[/b] ([i]Drift Scoring System[/i]) - The system for calculating scores on track in the Drift discipline.
[*][b]Preinitiation[/b] - Zone before the first sector, in which the scores are not counted. At the end of this zone the car must be in drift.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/da15c0b71cbc49434bb4d189dd9c1e1d8673bad4.png[/img]
[*][b]Line (or Trajectory)[/b] - The line way determined by the judicial task.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/99215385724bd18e292289dcb49436b9933344bd.png[/img]
[*][b]Speed[/b] - Vector physical quantity, characterizing the speed of movement and the direction of movement of the car on track.
[*][b]Angle[/b] - The value of degrees on which the car deviates relative to the velocity vector.
[*][b]Correction[/b] - The deviation from any parameter, determined by the referee's assignment, is for the worse.
[*][b]Clipping point[/b] (Clipper) - Landmark on the track, defined by the referee's task. They are divided into internal and external. To the internal you need to be close to the front bumper, to the external - the rear bumper.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/c46ad2b3b5f02012e9ee5624cc727bb676e9c38e.png[/img]
[*][b]Qualification[/b] - Qualifying single races, passing by the referee's task.
[*][b]Twin arrival[/b] - Arrival of two pilots, passing by the judge's task. Lead pilot - Leader. Chasing pilot - Chaser.
[*][b]Leader[/b] - The pilot who is driving the train. Goes ahead on the assignment of qualification.
[*][b]Chaser[/b] -  The pilot who adjusts for the arrival of the leader. Rides behind the leader, repeating his line.
[*][b]Distance to leader[/b] - Distance between the chasing car and the leader.
[/list]

[b]DSS. How it works?[/b]

DSS takes several basic parameters, of which the drift consists - speed, angle, trajectory, preinitiation, car setting and distance to the leader. Everything adds up and produces the final result. It's simple!

Each track is divided into a sector. Each sector has its own maximum score. The value is given by a percentage based on 100 points. This will be separately stipulated in the judge's task.

 In each sector there are clipping points, to which you need to be as close as possible, at the maximum possible angle and at the maximum possible speed. he main thing is not to overdo it, because for get off the track you automatically will get 0 points for the sector. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/bc2d5ad48a36f531963af2736a3730dd757725a0.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/7671fabc27ef94d7e2d8ecc7fe93c05c3aac7e89.png[/img]
Also, remember the trajectory that you must follow. You need to go smoothly, without correction, otherwise DSS punishes you. Even if you are ideally past the clipping point.  

There are some limitations on the track - cones that can not be knocked down. For the downed cone DSS prescribes 0 points for the whole race. (It is believed that you are trying to escape from the opponent, cutting the way.) And accordingly, the boundaries of the track - yellow markings, for which you can’t call in. 

In the pair races for the Chaser, the Leader arrives for the landmark. That is, the task of the Chaser is to repeat the leader, not allowing his mistakes.

[b]Summary[/b]
Perform a judicial task!

Thanks for your time.

Your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/hodcom/]Apro[/url].

Many thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/k4waii] CFW [/url] for his help in translating!

notes.title: About the global update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Driftheads![/h1]

[b]It's been a while.[/b] Yup, we're working full-time to take High Octane Drift to a whole new standards. Written from a scratch more realistic physics, more details on tracks, better effects and more gameplay. [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/c3280e80d17f1b05e403e724bdedaf727366f75b.jpg[/img]
In the course of getting it all together, we will publish more news updates on new aspects. You probably heard it before, but we didn't have special guys to take this over. Now we do. Meet [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/hodcom]Apro[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/k4waii]CFW[/url]. These will take care on community activities and russian propoganda.

We're moving towards more skilled and rewarding drifting within Drifting series. One of our official in-house series will be United Drift Championship (UDC). Drifting series will be covered in details in later posts.

[b]In the meantime,[/b] we are finishing tracks for UDC. [i]Accidentally[/i], they are the same as Formula Drift 2018 Pro Championship tracks with the same layouts. Long Beach, Orlando, Atlanta, NJ, Monroe, St.Louis, Texas and Final Round track. Speaking of which. Previous finals were held in legendary Irwindale. This year's final will take place in Las Vegas, due to Irwindale management announcement about seizing its operations. Somewhere by the end of 2017, they've made another breaking news - money were found and they will be kicking for at least next five years. [b]So[/b], where should we take our players for final round of UDC 2018 seasons: [b]Las Vegas or Irwindale?[/b] [u]Write your opinion in comments![/u]

Anyway, as we're getting where we wanted, we've planned some posts to cover new major things. Keep it up!

[h1]Current status[/h1]
[b]Internal testing intensifies.[/b]
We're actively testing, fixing and optimizing everything that we've found. Next phase will be closed testing and then open testing.

[h1]Community activity[/h1]
[list]
[*]First of all: Thanks to all those who believe in us, helps and makes this game better and more interesting. You are best! [i](haters too:D)[/i]
[*]Community manager [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/k4waii]CFW[/url] was launched Discord-server, welcome: [url=https://discord.gg/T27Dc4R]HOD Legacy[/url]!!!
[*]On the [url=https://discord.gg/T27Dc4R]Discord-server[/url] there are:
[list]
[*]Rules
[*]Moderators
[*]Support
[*]Game news
[*]Many sorted chats
[*]Good atmosphere
[*]Good cars settings
[/list]
[*]Also subscribe to our [i]Instagram[/i] [url=https://www.instagram.com/highoctanedrift.official/]@highoctanedrift.official[/url]
[*]The news will be published more often. Now [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/hodcom]Apro[/url] is responsible for them.
[/list]

notes.title: Brief announcement
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads! 

We're alive and rocking. Here is a short video we've put up together of a long beach drift course for our upcoming Drifting Series update: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uPNXShMLVrE

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/803d007bcd1392e0d88767a970366c0964de1f76.png[/img]
We've almost finished updating models of our current cars. Along with a pack of new ones. And some kickass bodykits. And we're gonna get new additional features to customize your look and car dynamics. It's pretty awesome. 
Next thing for modeling will be a couple of new garages and car interiors.

We've spent some time with controllers lately. More love for gamepads and steering wheels, yeah! Totally reworked input system which allows us to get different input axis and buttons values from almost any kind of input device. Force feedback is also refactored and became universal for all steering wheels* (using microsoft xinput, so whatever supports it), but needs to be polished a bit to have different kinds of additional steering wheel effects.

Car settings and parts are being transferred to physics update which will be launched for open tests rather soon.

After that, we'll make some additional internal testings for champs and will open it for a public test. Teams are next.

Right now, going to try to add some mods and editors for steam announcements to keep you updated on a regular basis. And to shed some more light on what the heck is it taking so long.

As always we are really grateful for your support, we couldn't be here without you. Keep it up and let's roll!

Cheers!

notes.title: European server 2HR technical break
notes.content:
Hey, what's up, driftheads?

First of all, we need to do some techincal stuff on european server for next couple of hours. It will be down from 06:00 GMT till ~ 08:00 GMT, if I read it correctly.

Next thing. We're alive and working non-stop on a new update with new physics, improved graphics, better optimization and new content. It's almost a brand new game :D. Sorry for keeping low profile, just too many things to carry on. We're hoping to improve it with making new admins from player base, which will update you on current state of development. I will make a new post with details on stuff we're working on with some gifs and images and blackjack and stuff.

Did you know you can already check first public beta of new client? You need to switch to beta in game preferences via steam: RIght mouse button on High Octane Drift in Steam Game Library -> Preferences -> Betas -> choose "test". It's a bit rough on a controllers, but we've already fixed it in internal beta builds. Soon we will release a series of betas, where we will update car or pack of cars with new models and new set up for updated physics.

Thanks again for all your support and comments. It's gonna be huge! :D
Cheers! 
- Iliya

notes.title: Happy New Year! Win 150G, WIP
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads!

Late Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! 

We've pushed a hotfix v0.3.4.5, fixing some blur rim bugs and other minor fixes. Also, there is a new free roam level. We decided to give it out for you to test the layout. Some bugs are expected.

---

We're working on fine tuning our physics update and porting some libraries to Unity engine. Probably, we'll give it out for testing next month or so (crossing fingers).

Also, actively modeling new tracks for our drifting series. There is a short dev video of early stages. Also, with our new e46 model in bodykit running new physics. Not the best video to showoff, but it's something. To make it more funny, here is the catch: track is being modeled after one famous real world drifting course. Name that course under youtube video to win 150Greens. Winner will be selected amongst youtube commenters using some random picker between 9th and 11th of Jan 2016. And, of course, you have to give right answer to win.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?edit=vd&v=Ndm3_T1NYqU]https://www.youtube.com/watch?edit=vd&v=Ndm3_T1NYqU[/url]

---

In an attempt to improve car engines sound quality, we've developed and implemented fancy granular synthesis method to sample engine sounds. I was pretty shocked how much car sound packs cost. Probably, because recording studios are focused on luxurious cars like Aston Martin and Gallardo. Anyway, we just went to a friendly STI owner to record his roaring Spec-C beauty.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/0cbaa830945537f59153d7a885a01eade3bd79d8.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/262e9bd1a059aaa84afeababeccb6d3b90c0c137.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/42a8a98791f80a82df74ab6a2b037d68a1832e1c.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/da0b75b4cf9821562b014cc7037e18c157c44e47.jpg[/img]

Haven't yet recieved a recording because of holidays, so expect some update later. If things go well, we could record some of the cars ourselves. That would be totally awesome :D

---

Still heading towards original car bodies. Half the distance passed.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/92821c6295746486d526e5e20bb34cf790597962.jpg[/img]

---

A quick update on things. Anyway, wishing everybody totally awesome new year. Keep calm and drift!

notes.title: v.0.3.4, European server, Testing New Scoring System
v.0.3.4, European server, Testing New Scoring System
v0.3.1 and roadmap
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads!

v0.3.1 brings new sponsor for levels 1 to 45. Easy greens, check it out. Full changelog is in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/457330/discussions/0/224446432327696828/]its thread[/url].

We haven't heard of a crashing bug for some time already. People say it's working now. Nicely done! :D

As far as general issues seem to be fixed, moving further. 
[list]
[*] We heard you about pretty tight f2p system, with not so many opportunities to get cash. Starting to add new sponsors already with pretty generous prizes. Also, we're gonna introduce a new type of events, work name "Marcus challenges", where you will be awarded different custom stuff for your car, like suspension, gearbox and so on. Working to add more greens to the economy.
[*] Car models are in the process of changing their bodies to look more like real-world prototypes. Also, we're thinking of ways how steam workshop will operate. At the moment, we have curated workshop and we can sell cars directly for real-world money, giving authors a share. Would like to hear your opinion on this.
[*] Vehicle dynamics is going to be changed a lot. We've refactored almost every aspect, body rolls and accelerations, gearbox, aerodynamics, new tire model and much more. This should solve all current "physics issues".  More updates on dynamics update later.
[*] Engine sounds are going to be replaced. We're trying a different approach on sound engine, should be a relief for ears.
[*] We've got some new tracks already which we need to polish a bit, check performance and publish it. 
[*] Teams and Drifting Series are on their way, more detailed update on each later.
[/list]

Sorry for communication lag, lots of stuff to be done. Thank you for your support and keep drifting fun!

notes.title: New Repair Policy, vinyls and fixes
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads.

Finally, you should have self-repair fully operational. It was a rather stupid bug causing fullscreen to hide panels.

Repair times and rates have now been changed.
[b]Self repair[/b] - 45 mins and 20% (was 150mins and 10%)
[b]Full paid repair[/b] - 10 mins 
[b]Single Category paid repair[/b] - 5 mins

If you feeling your car getting broken too often and "it's the engine again!", you should balance your engine parts to lower WEAROUT. Some parts give more torque but reduce durability. Best case scenario when your wear out index for engine somewhere lesser than 6-7. If you wish to discuss the need for repair at all, please do so in discussion and not in comments.

Getting vinyl wraps fixed, seems like they should work now. If they don't for you, you can open a discussion and paste link here in comments, so we can solve all these problems.

Other bugs are in the process of extermination. Still looking for the problem with crashes after connecting screen. Most of the time it is related to a video card. Make sure you have your drivers updated and there is no conflict with an integrated video card. You can also try to force the game to run a specific DirectX version by adding [b]-force-d3d9[/b] argument in [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=1040-JWMT-2947]Game Launch Options [/url].

Thank you for your feedback and support.

notes.title: Day3 fixes, x86 and REPORT THAT CRASH
notes.content:
Hi,

Firstly, we would like to ask to submit your bug and crash reports. We can't reproduce most of your connection and crashing issues. If you do experience something of it, please submit us a crash report. You can read more in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/457330/discussions/0/348293230314431704/]steam sticky post[/url], which will eventually lead you to our forum [url=http://cruderocks.com/?view=thread&id=24]post[/url]. Most detailed crash or severe bug reports will be awarded.

Secondly, in this brief fix we've addressed following issues:
[list]
[*] [b]Keyboard is not responding[/b] issue was addressed. We've made an additional check for logitech wrapping library which was causing the issue. We've given the fixed client for a test to some players, they said the issue is resolved. If it is not resolved for you, then submit a bug report (same way as a crash report)
[*] [b]Purchasing[/b] of cars and parts should be fixed. If you still experience some problems with that, please submit a bug report.
[*] Race results should be fixed and not stay there forever.
[*] Camera's view cycle should be fixed
[*] Self-repair button is in order now
[/list]

Thirdly, what issues are being addressed and may occur:
[list]
[*] [b]Spontaneous crashes[/b]. They are very system specific, please submit a crash log.
[*] [b]Disconnected from lobby[/b]. This state means that either:
[b]a. your firewall/antiviral is blocking traffic to our server (try to disable them for a while or add to exceptions)[/b];
b. your Microsoft Visual C++ is not installed correctly ([url=https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/download/details.aspx?id=48145]download[/url]);
c. your network address might be blocked by hosting firewall;
d. there was some kind of internal error.
In any case, please submit a bug report.
[*] Interface issues
[*] 180x UVs have a strange offset. Going to update model on oct. 18.
[/list]

And finally, we've uploaded an x86 version, which should be available to downloads.

notes.title: Захватывающий старт
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads!

Это было брутально. Запуститься в пятницу, наполучать фидбеков и кучу багов, и приступить к работе над ошибками только в понедельник.

В общем, большинство багов связано с настройками системы. Они не воспроизводятся на каждой машине.

По непонятным причинам Microsoft Visual C++, который должен был быть установлен вместе с игрой через Стим, этого не сделал. Если у вас возникают проблемы "Disconnect From Lobby" или что-то вроде "неправильная платформа", то можете попробовать установить редистрибутив самостоятельно: https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/download/details.aspx?id=48145

Проблема с [b]ХЕЛП!!1 Клавиатура не реагирует[/b] сейчас решается. Предположительно, конфликт библиотек или ПО.

Проблема с [b]НЕ МОГУ КУПИТЬ МАШИНУ[/b] так же решается в данный момент. В каких-то случаях ломается внутренняя база данных.

Решаются различные баги с интерфейсами и камерами.

Были определенные проблемы на стороне сервера, которые уже решены.

Сорри за общий бардак. Мы продолжаем работать над игрой, править баги и улучшать общий геймплей. Физика, графика и контент так же находятся в проработке.

Возможны небольшие задержки в обратной связи от нас.

Спасибо за поддержку и конструктивную критику.

notes.title: Breathtaking Start
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads!

That was savage. Releasing build on Friday, lots of feedback, even more bugs, no one to fix it on weekend.

Generally, most of the bugs are system specific. As they don't reproduce themselves on every rig.

For some reason, Microsoft Visual C++ which should be installed with the game, didn't make it. If you are experiencing [b]"disconnected from lobby"[/b] or [b]"wrong platform"[/b] issue, you might want to try to install it manually: https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/download/details.aspx?id=48145

[b]Keyboard is not responding[/b] issue is being addressed atm. Presumably, some software or libraries conflict. Expect a fix.

[b]WTF Can't buy a car[/b] issue is being worked on, presumably, internal database is messed up on some occasions. Bug being addressed.

Misc. interface bugs are being fixed as well. 

We've had some issues on server-side that were resolved. 

Sorry for any frustration you've got. We continue to work on the game, fix bugs, improve overall experience. Physics is being worked on, graphics and content as well.

Expect minor delays in feedback as we're getting our hands dirty.

Thanks for your support and constructive criticism.

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads! What up?)

It's been a long way to Steam release, but here it is. Early Access version b0.2.3. Only US server, as we've mentioned before. But EU server is coming right away.

We are expecting minor bugs, which could be annoying but shouldn't be critical. Please, report them through Steam Discussion or on our forum @ cruderocks.com

UPD: people already reporting keyboard not interacting >_<.  If you are using any kind of antiviral with sandbox mode, try shut it down for a while. We will investigate into it ASAP.

Some things might be a bit frustrating without proper helping tips, we're working on it. If that's the case don't hesitate to ask. There is a community of players migrating from different social networks, who can actually help with an advice.

Account transfer from Facebook to Steam will be covered in a different announcement.

Content is a bit rough in some places because we drag it since web-client prototype, but we're already putting effort to replace it and polish some new before going public.

Supposedly, next week we're going to open Workshop where you can upload custom car models straight to the game and send it to a curated High Octane Drift Steam Workshop. In case your model will actually make to the game, you will be paid royalties by Steam. We are pretty excited what opportunities it will bring. but more on that later.

Drift On!

notes.title: Delayed a bit
notes.content:
Hey, Driftheads!

tl;dr DELAYED TILL FRIDAY. Probably going to release it even earlier.

We're a bit delayed because I've messed up with Steam Store. We're going for Early Access as it gives certain advantages and suits best for our game. And I have to post a request in steam developers group for early access, didn't know that.

Done with the main reason :D  we're polishing every bug we could find to make it look like a "feature".

Cheers!
